notes.title: Internationalization update!
notes.notes: [p]Dear Wild Radio Fluxers,[/p][p][/p][p]in the past few days, we were working on another update for Wild Radio Flux game. [b]We are improving the internationalization support, in particular for the simplified Chinese language.[/b][/p][p]We finally fixed a very tedious bug that didn't allow the game to properly show Chinese language in the right way for users.[/p][p][b]We really apologize to all Chinese friends who were interested in playing Wild Radio Flux.[/b][/p][p]In addition, a couple of other variable bugs related to the translation system are now fixed, and translation should work properly.[/p][p][b]Further, we decided to make the game a bit easier to play due to some requests. Defeating enemies is now easier because we have reduced their power and energy.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you enjoy![/p][p]Love youuuuu![/p][p]Thanks to all Wild radio Fluxers[/p][p]from K Storm Studio ltd[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Wild Radio Flux 1st Major Update!
notes.notes:
Dear [b]Wild Radio Fluxers[/b],

We are so happy to see how many hours you spent on Wild Radio Flux. This is what drove us crazy and made us feel so happy about our work.
But we know Wild Radio Flux still needed some improvements based on your and curators' feedback to make the game more enjoyable, bigger and better, and this time we made a big update for this game, because we really want to make it bigger and better.
Below are some of the new features:

[b]- Stamina mode and Stamina bar for the HUD monitoring the ground or air dash
- Player message appears if you try to jump below when nothing is present
- Renovated UI
- Character, Season and Level selection screen have been completely redesigned
- Damage to the flashscreen added
- Fixed some minor bugs when press the small exit button in the game menu[/b]

We would love to grow this community, we would love to make this game more popular... we don't know if we can do it... for sure we will put our best, hope you enjoy!

Love youuuuuu!!!!

K Storm Studio Team

notes.title: New Characters update, animations and characters FX
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Wild Radio Fluxers,

after just 10 days from the game release in early access, we have another update already. We are constantly working on WRF to improve the gameplay, the appeal and the entire game too.

In this update:
[olist]
[*] We added more character animations for both Danny and Lizzy
[*] Character speed up and the gameplay now results more fluid and dynamic
[*] Character fire now starts more energetic, still respecting the RPG system
[*] Dust FX doesn't follow character anymore (Few other minor improvements)
[*] GameBook now autodisappears when related to any RPG in-game communication
[*] Added Dash shader FX
[*] And few other minor improvements
[/olist]

We hope you can enjoy these new improvements and keep playing Wild Radio Flux... the adventure has just begun!

notes.title: WRF Version 1.15 now live!
notes.notes:
Dear [b]Wild Radio Fluxers[/b],

We [b]just updated Wild Radio Flux[/b], fixing a few bugs that appeared to some of our players. Unfortunately, those tedious bugs didn't show up during the tests from us, early access testers, and Steam.

We do really apologize for the inconvenience! We hope you can keep enjoy WRF now and in the future. Other graphic and UI/UX updates are on the horizon, and we are working on new DLC already.

And please, [b]your feedbacks[/b] have been [b]more than gold[/b] for us, so we are always open to listen.
Thank you very very much,
Much Love
K Storm Studio Team

notes.title: Final Game Update!
notes.notes:
A GREAT IMMENSE THANKS to every person behind this project! We are so glad to tell you that Wild Radio Flux has been uploaded on Steam (and we are now waiting their test ːsteamthumbsupː )

After the Stem fest in October, many enthusiast players told us some major aspect that could significantly improve the game. And of course, working hard... we did it.

Well, I think the bullet list below can gives you more about what to find out in Wild Radio Flux game after this major update:


[list]
[*] [b]Wider View[/b]: that's been requested by several players and testers too. We zoomed out the game camera to 50%, so now the entire game view around your hero character can offers you more space to understand where to do.
[*] 
[*] [b]Power Attack[/b]: each hero character you select can activate a special attack in 3 directions. This attack is also more powerful than the standard attack and it causes from 2 to 4 time damages than the standard attack, multiply for the weapon and character class.
[*] 
[*] [b]More Gold Coins and Hidden Treasures[/b]: in Wild Radio Flux is crucial to have gold coins to spend for food and partially restore energy but especially to activate the Power Attack. That's why you placed more coins, hidden treasures and secret areas.
[*] 
[*] [b]New Soundtracks[/b]: yes at K Storm Studio we also have a dedicated section to produce music for our games and for Wild Radio Flux we created some soundtrack with a retro vibes!
[*] 
[*] [b]Dangerous Giant Machinery[/b]: that was already under development. We added dangerous giants machinery along the levels as a part of them.
[*] 
[*] [b]More New Bosses[/b]: we were already working about more bosses even along the levels to keep gameplay fresh.
[*] 
[*] [b]Redesigned UI[/b]: part of the game UI has been completely redesigned in a more modern way.
[*] 
[*] [b]Improved Backgrounds[/b]: we added more parallaxes (up to 30 in some cases) for both background and foreground, giving more dynamic to the player movement and a improving the graphical impact.
[/list]

... and now just under Steam test, then...  Wild Radio Flux!

notes.title: Running to the release!
notes.notes:
After one year of madness we can finally release WildRadioFlux! At least if we can pass the Steam test :) I know we planned to release WRF in 2023 but as a small company we've seen requests even for other projects we are working on, especially our K-Engine game engine and so we had to dedicate resources at 360.

Thank you so much everyone for your interest about our game, we are so happy and enthusiast about it! And we are still working in improving the last things for WRF then we hope to pass the Steam test and get WRF ready for all of you!.

In the meanwhile we wish you to have a wonderful 2024, stay in touch and get ready for all news from K Storm Studio. We hope you can have a great time with our games...

K Storm Studio Team
